title: Square Kilometers vs Square Miles: Country Size Comparisons
h1: Square kilometres and square miles — reading world atlases
description: Every country reports its area in one unit and expects the reader to convert. Here is the exact factor and a set of mental anchors for country-scale comparisons.

author.name: The Turbo Unit Converter engineering desk

hero: 1 sq mi = 2.59 km². The factor is easy; the anchor points that make it intuitive are the useful part.
body: Country-area comparisons routinely mix units. US almanacs quote sq mi. European almanacs quote km². UN statistical divisions publish both. A quick anchor set makes any comparison fluent.

> 1 mi² = 2.58999 km² (exact)
> 1 km² = 0.3861 mi²
> 100 km² ≈ 38.6 mi²; 1,000 mi² ≈ 2,590 km²

USA: 9.83 million km² = 3.80 million sq mi. Russia: 17.1 M km² = 6.60 M sq mi. France (metropolitan): 543,940 km² = 210,000 sq mi. UK: 243,610 km² = 94,058 sq mi. Japan: 377,975 km² = 145,937 sq mi. Memorising two or three of these gives you a mental scale for any country you encounter.

Texas is 696,241 km² — larger than France. California (423,970 km²) is larger than Germany (357,600 km²). Rhode Island (4,000 km²) is smaller than Luxembourg (2,586 km²)? No: Luxembourg is smaller. This is exactly the kind of comparison that flips depending on which almanac you consult, and always resolves the same way once you convert to a single unit.
## Worked example — Australia vs the contiguous US

Australia: 7.69 million km² = 2.97 million sq mi. Contiguous US (excluding Alaska and Hawaii): 8.08 million km² = 3.12 million sq mi. Australia is 95% the size of the lower 48 — closer than most people assume from Mercator maps, which stretch high-latitude areas dramatically.
Multiply sq mi by 2.59 for km². Multiply km² by 0.386 for sq mi. Anchor to France (~544,000 km²) or Texas (~696,000 km²) for a fast mental check.

faqs.q: How big is the Amazon rainforest?
faqs.a: About 5.5 million km² = 2.12 million sq mi — 60% of Brazil, larger than any single country except Russia.

faqs.q: Is Greenland really bigger than Africa?
faqs.a: No. Greenland is 2.17 million km²; Africa is 30.37 million km² — 14× larger. Mercator maps distort this dramatically.
